tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos man ngag kun gyi nying khu thugs dam nyams bzhes chag med rnam bzhir grags pa las bir srung phyi ma bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru bi rū pa pā dā ya/

bir srung thun mong ba'i nyams len ni/ skyabs sems spyi dang 'dra/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan la bsten cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan dang do shal byas shing*/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gus 'dud drag po dang ldan pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la sngags kyi sgra grag stong la sems gtad nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li/ badz+ra ka pā li/ badz+ra dhi na/ ban+dhu hā ra/ badz+ra pi aṃ/ hu tsang ge pa ra bhe ta na/ kha ge e/ aṃ ge mi li/ le ga par ta/ ta u la/ ti pā ṭa/ oṃ bi rū wa pa ra/ na mo bhe ta ni/ wa ra ṇa/ zhes pa tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ dam bca' bzhin du bzla/ mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las gcig du bsdus pa'i dngos// bla ma rnams dang dpal ldan bir+wa pa// gnyis su med la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// mgon po khyed kyi thugs dang bdag gi sems// dbye ba med par gcig tu 'dres gyur nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba khyed ci 'dra// bdag kyang de 'drar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs//

zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma bir+wa pa de nyid rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis pad+ma dang zla ba ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rang nyid rje btsun bir+wa pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan la bsten cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan dang do shal byas shing*/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyed/ rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bskyed rim gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan par/ rang gi lus kyi 'dug stangs kyang bi rū pa bsgoms pa dang 'dra bar byas te mig gnyis sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la gtad nas/ ngag gis rlung lan gcig bus shing phyir mnan/ sems kyis nad gdon sdig sgrib gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad par bsam/ rlung mi thub pa dang nang du dal bus bsdus nas/ bum pa can 'dzin dus phyi rol du me ri dmar nag gis yongs su bskor nas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom/ yang gong bzhin rlung bus shing phyir mnan/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ste/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ rlung nang du bsdus nas bum pa can 'dzin dus/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla bre dang bcas pa'i thun mong ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos gang la'ang nyam nga ba dang*/ bag tsha ba cung zad tsam yang med snyam pa'i bskyed rim rnam pa gsal zhing shin tu brten par bskyed/ de nas srung ba gnyis bsgom pa'i dang po rdo rje rtse gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/

lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyangs pa dpral bar reg ste/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ liṅgar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yar rim dang*/ yang liṅgar reg la/ bir+wa/ lte bar reg la/ pa/ snying gar reg la/ pra/ khar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ dpral bar reg la/ swā hā/ sngags 'di rnams rlung gzung ba'i bar du brjod cing*/ swā hā'i rjes la phyag rgya bkrol te/ g.yon pas se gol brdab/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba la/ lus kyi 'dug stangs 'phags pa'i ltar/ rkang pa gnyis kyi brang sa la btsugs/ rting pa gnyis 'phongs la gtad/ pus mo gnyis phyir dgyel/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyir bsdoms pa las mthe bong gnyis/ gung mo gnyis/ mthe'u chung gnyis rnams rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rlung bum pa can gyi ngang nas sngags rnams yid kyis zlos shing mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ mthe'u chung gnyis bshang sgor reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang mthe'u chung gnyis slar bshang sgor reg la/ bir+wa/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg la/ pa/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ pra/ mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ swā hā/ zhes mas rim dang*/ yang gong bzhin snying ga nas bshang sgo'i bar phyag rgyas reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma nas/ wa pa 'i bar gyi sngags yid kyis zlos shing rlung btang la/ lag pa gnyis kyis se gol gtog par bya'o// de ltar rdzogs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces bir srung phyi ma'i nyams len sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyi blo mtsho las so//
//bkra shis// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
